_comment: SPARK — S165 P5b: the PORTRAIT half of R137's twelve zone backgrounds, for PITCH_2P.
⭐ EVERY ONE IS SEEDED OFF ITS OWN `-4p` LANDSCAPE via refImages, which is R137's stated method:
*"they should be very similar but still a tad different"*. Seeding off the sibling rather than off
the banner is what makes them a PAIR — same palette, same landmarks, same time of night — while the
recomposition for a tall frame supplies the 'tad different'.
⚠ 3:4 IS THE NEAREST PORTRAIT THE GENERATOR OFFERS. The real PITCH_2P zone is 960x1080 = 8:9
(0.889); 3:4 is 0.75. The renderer covers-and-crops. Recorded so a later session measuring 3:4
against 960x1080 does not read it as a bug.
⛔ AND THE RECOMPOSITION IS NOT A CROP. On PITCH_2P the castle sits in the GOALMOUTH — mid-height,
against the touchline — not in an outer corner, so the frame's weight moves. Each prompt therefore
asks for the same world stacked VERTICALLY: horizon high, the open empty ground running down the
tall middle of the frame, landmarks pushed to the top corners and the very bottom edge.
sharedStyle: A DARK, MOODY, LOW-CONTRAST environment backdrop for a game board — a wide empty landscape with
no characters and no foreground clutter.
Painted in a stylised cartoon-illustration style with soft ink linework and flat shading, a little
more realistic and less saturated than a poster — muted, near-monochrome, atmospheric.
⛔ IT MUST STAY DARK AND QUIET. Overall value is deep and shadowed, like a scene lit only by
moonlight or distant embers. NO bright passages, no white or near-white areas, no strong
highlights, no hard focal point, no busy detail, nothing that would compete with brightly coloured
game pieces drawn on top of it. Think of it as a faded mural seen through darkness.
⛔ EMPTY MIDDLE GROUND. The centre of the frame must stay open, plain and uncluttered — structures
and terrain features belong around the EDGES of the frame. Nothing may occupy or draw the eye to
No characters, no people, no creatures, no animals, no vehicles.
No text, no lettering, no words, no logo, no border, no frame, no vignette, no UI, no map markers.
Fills the entire frame edge to edge with no margin and no letterboxing.
TALL PORTRAIT COMPOSITION: the horizon sits HIGH in the frame, and the open empty ground runs
down the whole tall middle. Terrain features and structures are pushed to the TOP CORNERS and the
very BOTTOM EDGE. The vertical centre band of the image stays open, plain and uncluttered.

characters.name: zone-vampires-2p
characters._race: vampires — crimson 0xff3b6b — Carpathian mountain night (⚠ SETTING IS MINE, owner Q1 open)
characters.prompt: A Carpathian mountain valley at night, seen from a distance. Black jagged pine forest along the lower edges, steep bare crags rising at the far left and right, a thin cold mist lying in the hollow, a sliver of moon behind torn cloud. Everything is deep blue-black and charcoal. Faint CRIMSON accents only: a dull red glow in a handful of distant windows on a far crag, and a cold crimson rim light along the topmost cloud edge. The centre of the valley floor is open, empty and featureless. Recompose this same location as a TALL VERTICAL scene: keep the identical palette, the identical landmarks and the identical time of night as the reference image, but arrange them for a tall portrait frame with the horizon high, the landmarks at the top corners and along the bottom edge, and the open empty ground running down the middle.

characters.name: zone-nagas-2p
characters.prompt: A drowned military citadel on the deep sea floor, seen from a distance. Everything is deep teal-black and slate. Faint CYAN accents only: a cold cyan glow leaking from arrow-slits in the far walls and a thin cyan shimmer on the drifting silt. The centre of the sea floor is open, empty and featureless.
